title: 037 M-of-N vote (4 of 8 raw buys) as a SimpleTrigger entry trigger: alone (vs gbb) and as a second book beside the width book (shared wallet)
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); the vote was chosen and confirmed with the late half in view (037 tradeable-bars M-of-N screen), so the late half is NOT blind. Nothing is adopted.

why_these.st_mofn48: the only M-of-N confirmed in the 037 tradeable-bars re-run (indicator_screen/vol/mofn.json): label:tbatr_buy, all bars, M=4 of N=8, lift 1.18 / 1.13 / 1.19 (early/late/E0) vs width book 1.09 / 1.11 / 0.96; fires on ~0.4% of bars. On label:tb_buy (what fixed-% exits pay) it was NOT confirmed (1.16 / 1.17 vs width 1.62 / 1.62).

signals: members CMO, ZScore, LWRevert, ROC, Ehlers_Indicator:cycle, CMF, WTO, EMACross; each the class's raw buy computed by the 037 harvest's OWN path (populate_path + overrides.raw_signals, atr_ok forced True, Parameter defaults); 0 mismatches vs the 037 harvest on all 11 pairs, full history, warm-up 200 bars excluded (research/mofn_trigger/instrument.json), checked before this file was committed
setup: SimpleTriggerStrategy, PRESET ARM_D_FAMILY, family reversion (most members are oversold/turn legs) -> the reversion exits of the gbb comparator; config_wf; 15 folds f00-f14
instrument: trigger causality PASS (research/outcomes/causality.py --write, all triggers re-run); no zero-trade half; arm trades >= 100 over 15 folds, else INCONCLUSIVE
alone: judge_one(arm, st_fam_gbb) (early gain > 0, late gain > 0, paired and risk not WORSENED; rule maps below)
beside_width_book: evaluation/books.py combine + shared_wallet (one wallet of stake x max_open_trades; refused and shrunk entries counted) of [w_aro, arm] vs w_aro alone: PASS = combined early AND late totals above w_aro's, AND the whole-period paired verdict (halves.split, split_after f14) not WORSENED; same-pair overlaps between the books reported (they need two sub-accounts)
decision: both verdicts reported; 'candidate trigger' if either PASSes. One arm is tested; report p values
note: The screen favoured this vote only on the volatility-neutral label; the backtest pays fixed-% reversion exits (ARM_D_FAMILY), where the screen said 'no'. A FAIL here may be the exits, not the entry -- reported, not used to re-pick anything.
